title: Add live trigger flashlight intensity controls
objective: Implement live-mode controls so left and right gamepad triggers decrease and increase flashlight intensity during examples/flashlight/run.py teleop.
instructions: Inspect the current live teleop/input loop and existing flashlight intensity/profile application before editing.
Add live gamepad trigger handling: left trigger decreases flashlight intensity, right trigger increases flashlight intensity.
Apply changes to the existing live SpotLightComponent at runtime without rebuilding/restarting the scene.
Use pragmatic defaults that feel controllable in live teleop, with clamping so intensity cannot go negative or explode unbounded.
Expose small CLI knobs if needed for intensity step/rate/min/max, but keep the default spear live ... --setting realistic-2x command working without extra flags.
Log enough state for the user to know runtime intensity controls are active and what the current intensity is when it changes.
Add or update tests around the control logic using existing fake input/component patterns.
Update user-facing docs only if there is an existing appropriate section for live controls.
constraints: Do not perform Git commits or pushes.
Do not touch Control Tower transient/session/run artifacts.
Do not modify unrelated lighting/RT behavior beyond what is needed for trigger intensity adjustment.

artifacts: Committed hardware RT live flashlight controls baseline as 1b7a8636ce852df7e424fb3d20f2fc102f714ce8; branch is ahead of origin by 12 and was not pushed.

expected_outputs: Implemented runtime trigger intensity adjustment for live flashlight teleop.
Tests added/updated and verification commands run, with any unavailable tools reported.
definition_of_done: Left/right trigger behavior is implemented, bounded, and covered by focused tests.
